explanation: All 1485 runs-conceded differences have one cause: sqlite.db's is_bye, is_legbye and is_penalty flags are 0 on every row, so the existing site's formula (total_runs minus extras when those flags are set) never removes byes, leg-byes or penalties. The warehouse side is higher by 7,142 runs; the current archive records 7,142 bye, leg-bye and penalty runs outside super overs — an exact match. global.db charges bowlers only batter runs + wides + no-balls. The existing IPL site was not changed (Batch 1 scope); this affects its economy figures.
Runs, balls faced, dismissals, legal balls and bowler wickets agree exactly for every player-season.
